title: Security request funnel and priority ledger for enterprise customers
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide range of security and compliance requests (SOC2 evidence, ISO questionnaires, HIPAA onboarding, EU DPA clarifications, and large vendor questionnaires). Our current handling is ad-hoc: requests land in multiple inboxes, triage is manual, SLAs vary with customer tier, and engineers get unexpected work.

Goal: Build a deterministic, auditable funnel and a priority ledger that classifies incoming security/compliance asks, assigns a risk-and-effort weighted priority score, routes the work to the right lane (auto-response, security team, legal, engineering solutions), and exposes clear SLAs and customer-facing expectations. The ledger should be explainable for auditors and support reporting (MTTR, SLA attainment, time-per-question).

Scope: Non-bug enterprise requests only (security/compliance questionnaires, DPA clarifications, SOC2 evidence requests, HIPAA onboarding checklists, vendor security forms). Excludes incident response, vulnerability triage, or product security bugs.

Success metrics: 1) 40% reduction in manual reassignment within 3 months, 2) 95% SLA adherence for fast-track lane, 3) reduced average time-to-first-response for Tier-1 customers from 48h to 8h.
acceptance_criteria: An intake form + email parsing pipeline captures required metadata (customer tier, ask type, affected product, region, requested due date, supporting docs) into the ticket record
Automated classifier tags incoming asks into one of: EvidenceRequest, Questionnaire, DPAClarification, HIPAAOnboarding, Other with >=85% precision on held-out sample
Priority ledger computes a score composed of: customer_tier(40%), data_sensitivity(25%), contractual_obligation(20%), estimated_engineering_hours(10%), and legal_risk_multiplier(5%)
Routing rules map score ranges to lanes: Fast-track (score >= 80), Standard (50-79), Low-touch (<50), with configurable SLA targets per lane
Auto-responder templates exist for common evidence requests and are triggered for Low-touch and some Standard lane items
Dashboard shows queue sizes, SLA attainment by lane, mean time to resolve, and top questionnaire templates by frequency
Audit trail records manual overrides with reviewer, reason, and timestamp
Documentation and customer messaging templates are published to the help center and linked in automated replies

2026-03-10 Ava Martinez: Merging classifier experiment results into ticket; current accuracy 87% on label set. Moving to build routing rules and SLA configuration tab in console.
decisions: Use single unified intake endpoint (form + email parser + API) that normalizes metadata into ticket fields
Priority score is opinionated but deterministic; exact weights decided for initial launch and will be tunable via admin UI
Auto-response will be conservative: only trigger when confidence of classifier > 0.9 or when evidence-pack exists for the template
Evidence storage will reuse existing Confluence/Drive-based evidence-store with links in ticket rather than duplicating binary assets
Manual override requires recording reviewer and reason (auditability requirement from Security/Legal)
